US Secretary of State Rubio Discusses Venezuelan Oil with Indian Refiners

US Secretary of State Antony Blinken, referred to as Rubio in one outlet, visited a major Indian city to discuss the refining of Venezuelan crude oil with Indian companies, specifically Reliance. The proposal involves Reliance refining thick, sulfur-heavy Venezuelan crude, which requires specialized and costly equipment that only certain refineries possess. The visit and discussions focused on India potentially handling this type of crude oil.
